description: Standard mutual NDA with a one-sided, perpetual confidentiality survival clause and an unusually broad definition of confidential information.
contract_text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

1. Confidential Information. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by either party, in any form, without any marking or designation requirement, including information that is publicly available.

2. Survival. The obligations of confidentiality under this Agreement shall survive in perpetuity and shall not terminate upon expiration or termination of this Agreement.

3. Term. This Agreement shall remain in effect for one (1) year from the Effective Date.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

expected_findings.reason: Perpetual survival of confidentiality obligations combined with an overbroad, unmarked definition of confidential information is atypical and disadvantageous.

description: MSA with an uncapped, one-sided indemnification clause and mandatory binding arbitration waiving jury trial and class actions.
contract_text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

5. Indemnification. Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client from any and all claims, damages, losses, and expenses, without limitation, arising from Contractor's performance of the Services, regardless of fault.

6. Dispute Resolution. Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration administered by [Arbitration Body]. Each party waives any right to a jury trial and to participate in a class action.

7. Payment Terms. Client shall pay Contractor within thirty (30) days of receipt of a correct invoice.

expected_findings.reason: Uncapped, one-sided indemnification with no fault requirement is atypical downside risk for the indemnifying party.
Mandatory arbitration with jury/class-action waivers is common but still worth flagging as a rights trade-off.

description: Standard YC post-money SAFE with market-standard terms -- should score as low risk.
contract_text:
SIMPLE AGREEMENT FOR FUTURE EQUITY (SAFE)

This SAFE is issued in connection with a Post-Money Valuation Cap of $8,000,000. Upon an Equity Financing, this SAFE will convert into shares of the same class as sold in the Equity Financing at the lower of the Valuation Cap or the price set by the Equity Financing. The Investor has no voting rights, no board seat, and no information rights beyond those provided to all SAFE holders as a class.

description: Influencer sponsorship agreement granting the brand perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide ownership of all content and the creator's likeness with no royalty.
contract_text:
SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT

3. Content Ownership. Creator hereby irrevocably assigns to Brand, in perpetuity and throughout the universe, all right, title, and interest in and to the Content, including Creator's name, image, and likeness, for use in any media now known or hereafter devised, without additional compensation.

4. Fee. Brand shall pay Creator a one-time fee of $2,000 upon delivery of the Content.

expected_findings.reason: Perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide assignment of content and likeness rights with a one-time flat fee and no royalty is a severe, atypical downside for the creator.
